_comment: The probes the 7.3 line's image gate asks about. Each one names a string that exists in one of our own sources and has to exist in the kernel image that is about to be flashed. The gate checks both halves separately: a needle that is no longer in the source it is attributed to is a stale probe, and a needle that is missing from the image means the code was not built into the kernel that goes on the board. The release line carries a different list - its kernel has different drivers in it - so the list lives in a manifest of its own rather than inside the tool.
_sources_comment: Every probe lists its sources in the order they should be looked for: the tree that is about to be built comes first, the patch that creates the file second, and the board layer of this repository last. The tree is the authoritative source in the build; the others are what the same claim can be checked against when there is no tree at hand, and they carry the same strings because the tree is made of them.
